messages:
marco-sales: Heads up - prospect (big healthcare org) wants us to run the logging vendor through our vendor security questionnaire. They're pushing for completed SIG/CAIQ + evidence.

akiko: Which vendor is it? If it's a managed SaaS log store we should check subprocessors and whether they store raw customer logs indefinitely.

marco-sales: Vendor = StreamVault. They claim SOC2, have a CAIQ in their portal. Customer specifically asked if StreamVault will see decrypted PHI during ingestion.

devon: Important: does StreamVault do any parsing or enrichment that requires decryption? If so that's higher risk. We should map CAIQ answers to our control set and document any gaps.

akiko: Quick template we use for the customer: "We have reviewed the vendor's CAIQ and SOC2 reports and require the following mitigations: encryption in transit and at rest, subprocessors list, breach notification within 72 hours, and data deletion within 30 days after request."

security-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: Create VENDOR-2026-122 ticket and attach vendor CAIQ link.

marco-sales: Also asking about keys: StreamVault uses provider-managed keys only. Customer may request BYOK/CMK.

legal-review: If vendor won't offer CMK, we often require tighter contractual commitments and an annual attestation. For regulated data, legal may require the vendor be scoped out or we run a private logging pipeline.

marco-sales: Can someone estimate time to complete the review (internal) and to respond to customer?

akiko: If vendor provides CAIQ + SOC2 and no red flags, internal review ~2 business days. If we need vendor negotiation on CMK or subprocessors, add 1-3 weeks.

devon: Also check their incident response runbook and whether they have forensics retention. Healthcare customers will ask for forensic evidence retention windows.

marco-sales: Cool. I'll set expectation with customer: ~48-72 hours for initial answer (assuming docs), escalated if vendor needs legal negotiation.

legal-review: Tag @security for a final decision on whether this vendor is allowed to process PHI under our current policy.

marco-sales: Thanks team. I'll upload vendor CAIQ when I get the link.

security-bot: TICKET CREATED: VENDOR-2026-122 - StreamVault onboarding. Assigned to @devon. Due 2026-04-02.
